examples.text: Ele já disse à polícia o ocorrido.
examples.en: He has already told the police what happened.

examples.text: Você não quer falar sobre o ocorrido?
examples.en: Don't you want to talk about what happened?

examples.text: Ainda estou esperando que me digam o ocorrido.
examples.en: I'm still waiting to be told what happened.

examples.text: Tom disse que sentia muito pelo ocorrido ontem à noite.
examples.en: Tom said he was sorry for last night.
